scenes.text: On this day in seventeen ninety seven, a man jumped from a balloon with a silk parachute.
His name was André-Jacques Garnerin, and he rose high above Paris.
There was no harness, just a small basket hanging under the silk canopy.
Then he cut the rope to the balloon, and dropped.
The parachute swung so wildly that people in the crowd reportedly fainted.
But he landed safely, got on a horse, and rode back to cheering crowds.
Would you have been brave enough to try it first?

title: The first parachute jump happened on this day in 1797 🪂
caption: On October 22, 1797, André-Jacques Garnerin cut himself loose from a balloon above Parc Monceau in Paris and floated down under a silk parachute. It swung so hard that spectators fainted, but he landed safely!
